audit.why: Early lane is Galio's (825-range Q vs your 525 E, taunt engage, MR-flavoured durability); mid is roam-denial against Hero's Entrance; side lane and teamfights are where Viktor's zone control pays. TRICKY 7/10 fits, though the 53.72% Viktor win rate over 4873 games says the matchup is statistically winnable.

audit.whatIsWrong: phases[4].why used the fabricated name 'Chaos Storm' and spikes[0].text used 'Death Ray'; real names are Arcane Storm (R) and Hextech Ray (E). Spike structure itself (Lost Chapter, 6, Luden's, augments) is right.
audit.why: Kit file: Viktor E is Hextech Ray (12/11/10/9/8), R is Arcane Storm (120/100/80). Mirror audit made the same corrections on Galio's page.
audit.corrected: Both fabricated names replaced; spike text now carries Q's 11s rank-1 cooldown as the trade window.

audit.whatIsWrong: The decisive interactions were under-stated: Justice Punch is Galio's only engage (11s rank 1) and Viktor has no dash; Colossal Smash is an auto-reset whose wind-up telegraphs the combo; Shield of Durand (18s) taunt follows the knockup; Winds of War at 825 out-ranges every Viktor ability.
audit.why: Kit flags: Galio P autoReset, E dash/knockup 650 range 11/10/9/8/7, W hardCC+shield 18/17/16/15/14, R knockup+shield 4000/4750/5500. Viktor has no mobility spell. Matches the mirror's findings from the other side.
audit.corrected: Cooldown field now carries the 11s/18s/17s numbers; the Colossal Smash reset tell is stated; the copy-paste Do's/Don'ts bullets replaced with the actual interactions.

audit.why: It is the field that must hold real numbers.
audit.corrected: Now carries Justice Punch 11s, Shield of Durand 18s, Gravity Field 17s.

audit.whatIsWrong: Page never mentioned that Galio's combo opens with the Colossal Smash auto-reset (the wind-up is the step-back tell), flagged in missingInteractions.
audit.why: Kit flag: Galio P is an auto-attack reset.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - Guard your W Gravity Field like a fifth summoner spell. - Ultimate goes to kill windows only.
edits.after: - Galio Justice Punch: 11s at rank 1 — his only engage; he cannot start a fight while it is down. Read it like a second minimap. - His Shield of Durand taunt is 18s. - Your Gravity Field is 17s: guard it like a fifth summoner.

edits.before: E through the wave into his chest, Q-shield the response, empowered-auto, and walk — a full trade where his answer hit a shield.
edits.after: Justice Punch reaches 650 and flies straight — fire the laser from off-angles past that range and he must eat it or burn E on nothing.

edits.before: That is Galio’s whole plan in one window — decline politely and watch it retire.
edits.after: His Colossal Smash reset winds up first — step back on the tell, not the punch.

edits.before: Casting E at melee-adjacent range against a loaded engage — Viktor's cast times are an assassin's favorite metronome.
edits.after: Drop Gravity Field on his approach, not after Justice Punch connects — the taunt follows the knockup faster than a late W lands.

edits.before: Galio wins by landing Justice Punch, denying your pattern, and starting the fight your kit wanted ten seconds later.
edits.after: Galio wins by punching you into a taunt, shrugging your magic damage with Shield of Durand, and flying bot with Hero's Entrance.

edits.before: You are the evolved teamfight: W their entry, E the clump, steer the storm through their carries, and Q-shield whatever reaches you. Glorious indeed.
edits.after: Don't burst the statue — W his Hero's Entrance landing, E the clump behind him, steer the storm onto their carries, and Q-shield the taunt attempt.

edits.before: Galio's passive magic resistance and his W (Shield of Durand) damage reduction make your E (Death Ray) poke feeble, and his Q (Winds of War) out-ranges and out-sustains you on the wave. He shoves you in and pokes with Q while eating your magic damage. Don't try to win the poke war; just farm and match pushes.
edits.after: His W (Shield of Durand) blunts your magic burst and his Q (Winds of War) at 825 range out-reaches your E (Hextech Ray) at 525, so he shoves and pokes while eating your damage. His Q is 11s at rank 1 — laser him inside that window. Don't try to win the poke war; just farm and match his pushes.

edits.before: E online: the laser farms AND pokes in one cast. Aim it through minions into his chest on every wave contact.
edits.after: E online: the laser farms and pokes in one cast, but his 825-range Q answers — even trades until someone missteps.

edits.before: Full kit: W zones his aggression and the E-Q-auto trade pattern is fully armed. Stack your first augment quietly.
edits.after: His full kit arrives too: 11s Justice Punch into taunt beats your trade pattern up close. Poke only outside 650.

edits.before: Lost Chapter timing — laser every wave contact and bank Manaflow. Each augment makes the same spells quietly crueler.
edits.after: His Q out-ranges you and Shield of Durand eats your burst — he shoves and chips while you bank Manaflow and survive.

edits.before: Chaos Storm online — your all-in answer and teamfight entry. In lane it's the kill: W-E-R on anyone who oversteps.
edits.after: Hero's Entrance turns his shove into cross-map kills you cannot match — mirror his crash and ping every disappearance.

edits.before: Luden's spike: the laser chunks a third bar and the storm executes the remainder. Force extended rotations.
edits.after: His first-item bulk and W reduction blunt your Luden's spike — you chip, he shrugs, the 1v1 still is not yours.

edits.before: Evolved late-game Viktor is a zone the enemy can't enter: W the choke, E the clump, and steer R through the retreat.
edits.after: He still wins the direct duel — taunt plus peel outlasts your burst. Zone with W and R and kill past him, not through him.

notes: Chart aligned to the content layer and packet levelChart (Galio, Skill, Galio x5): the full layer's blanket 'Skill' on phases 2-6 was a pre-existing full/content disagreement; content and packet agree, so full was moved. Left the prose (length-banded fields, could not rewrite everything) but it should be re-grounded in a later pass. Viktor R's derived 'channel' flag looks like a tooltip parse of 'interrupting enemy channels'; did not assert interruptibility anywhere, matching the mirror's call.
